body.x: NEW YORK, USA (AVING) -- <Visual News> Samsung has presented its new mobile LED type DLP projector ‘Pocket Imager(model : SP-P300MK).
If you install a dedicated battery to the model, you can use it wherever for about 2 hours and half without the need for extra power supply.
This model is equipped with color LED lamps instead of a color wheel and lamp to make it portable size.
It measures 12.7cm x 9.45 cm x 5.08cm and weighs in at 700g.
By employing 8 color LED lamps and German Carl Zeiss lens, it boasts for its outstanding color reproduction and clear display. According to the company, it can run for more than 10,000 hours.
This model has won several design awards such as CES 2006 Innovation award, iF award, and Japanese & Korean good design.
